title: Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices

obligations.text: These Directions shall be applicable to all Banking Companies, Corresponding New Banks and State Bank of India as defined under section 5 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 (commercial banks), including Foreign Banks, Small Finance Banks and Payments Banks.
obligations.applies_to: Banking Companies, Corresponding New Banks and State Bank of India (commercial banks)
obligations.quote: These Directions shall be applicable to the following entities (collectively referred to as ‘regulated entities’ or ’REs’ in these directions): (i) all Banking Companies1, Corresponding New Banks and State Bank of India

obligations.text: These Directions shall be applicable to NBFCs as defined under clause (f) of section 45I of the RBI Act, 1934 that are included in the Top Layer, Upper Layer and Middle Layer under the Scale Based Regulation framework.
obligations.applies_to: Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) in Top Layer, Upper Layer and Middle Layer
obligations.quote: Non-Banking Financial Companies (hereinafter referred to as ‘NBFCs’) as defined under clause (f) of section 45I of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 and included in the ‘Top Layer’, ‘Upper Layer’ and ‘Middle Layer’

obligations.text: These Directions shall be applicable to Credit Information Companies as defined under the Credit Information Companies (Regulation) Act, 2005.
obligations.quote: Credit Information Companies as defined under clause (e) of section 2 of the Credit Information Companies (Regulation) Act, 2005

obligations.text: These Directions shall be applicable to EXIM Bank, NABARD, NaBFID, NHB and SIDBI as All India Financial Institutions.
obligations.applies_to: All India Financial Institutions (EXIM Bank, NABARD, NaBFID, NHB, SIDBI)
obligations.quote: EXIM Bank, National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (‘NABARD’), National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (‘NaBFID’), National Housing Bank (‘NHB’) and Small Industries Development Bank of India

obligations.text: Foreign banks operating in India through branch mode must follow a 'comply or explain' approach to the applicability of these Directions, deviating from a specific part only with a reasonably justifiable explanation that the Reserve Bank examines and accepts as part of the supervisory process.
obligations.applies_to: foreign banks operating in India through branch mode
obligations.quote: Further, such foreign banks shall be subject to a ‘comply or explain’ approach in terms of the applicability of these Directions.

obligations.text: REs shall put in place a robust IT Governance Framework based on the focus areas of strategic alignment, risk management, resource management, performance management and Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery Management.
obligations.quote: REs shall put in place a robust IT Governance Framework based on the aforementioned focus areas that inter alia:

obligations.text: The IT Governance Framework shall specify the governance structure and processes necessary to meet the RE's business/strategic objectives.
obligations.quote: specifies the governance structure and processes necessary to meet the RE's business/ strategic objectives;

obligations.text: The IT Governance Framework shall specify the roles (including authority) and responsibilities of the Board of Directors (Board) / Board level Committee and Senior Management.
obligations.quote: specifies the roles (including authority) and responsibilities of the Board of Directors (Board) / Board level Committee and Senior Management;

obligations.text: The IT Governance Framework shall include adequate oversight mechanisms to ensure accountability and mitigation of IT and cyber/information security risks.
obligations.quote: includes adequate oversight mechanisms to ensure accountability and mitigation of IT and cyber/ information security risks.

obligations.text: The enterprise-wide risk management policy or operational risk management policy shall incorporate periodic assessment of IT-related risks (both inherent and potential risk).
obligations.quote: Enterprise-wide risk management policy or operational risk management policy shall also incorporate periodic assessment of IT-related risks (both inherent and potential risk).

obligations.text: Strategies and policies related to IT, Information Assets, Business Continuity, Information Security, and Cyber Security (including Incident Response and Recovery Management/Cyber Crisis Management) shall be approved by the Board of Directors.
obligations.quote: The strategies and policies related to IT, Information Assets, Business Continuity, Information Security, Cyber Security (including Incident Response and Recovery Management/ Cyber Crisis Management) shall be approved by the Board of Directors.

obligations.text: Such IT, information asset, business continuity, information security and cyber security strategies and policies shall be reviewed at least annually by the Board.
obligations.quote: Such strategies and policies shall be reviewed at least annually by the Board.

obligations.text: REs shall establish a Board-level IT Strategy Committee (ITSC).
obligations.quote: REs shall establish a Board-level IT Strategy Committee (ITSC)8.

obligations.text: While constituting the ITSC, REs shall ensure that the ITSC has a minimum of three directors as members.
obligations.quote: While constituting the ITSC, REs shall ensure: (i) Minimum of three directors as members;

obligations.text: While constituting the ITSC, REs shall ensure that the Chairperson of the ITSC is an independent director and has substantial IT expertise in managing/guiding information technology initiatives.
obligations.quote: The Chairperson of the ITSC shall be an independent director and have substantial IT expertise9 in managing/ guiding information technology initiatives; and

obligations.text: While constituting the ITSC, REs shall ensure that members of the ITSC are technically competent.
obligations.quote: (iii)  Members are technically competent10.

obligations.text: The ITSC shall meet at least on a quarterly basis.
obligations.quote: The ITSC shall meet at least on a quarterly basis.

obligations.text: The ITSC shall ensure that the RE has put an effective IT strategic planning process in place.
obligations.quote: (i) Ensure that the RE has put an effective IT strategic planning process in place;

obligations.text: The ITSC shall guide in preparation of the IT Strategy and ensure that the IT Strategy aligns with the overall strategy of the RE towards accomplishment of its business objectives.
obligations.quote: Guide in preparation of IT Strategy and ensure that the IT Strategy aligns with the overall strategy of the RE towards accomplishment of its business objectives;

obligations.text: The ITSC shall satisfy itself that the IT Governance and Information Security Governance structure fosters accountability, is effective and efficient, has adequate skilled resources, well defined objectives and unambiguous responsibilities for each level in the organisation.
obligations.quote: Satisfy itself that the IT Governance and Information Security Governance structure fosters accountability, is effective and efficient, has adequate skilled resources,

obligations.text: The ITSC shall ensure that the RE has put in place processes for assessing and managing IT and cybersecurity risks.
obligations.quote: Ensure that the RE has put in place processes for assessing and managing IT and cybersecurity risks;

obligations.text: The ITSC shall ensure that budgetary allocations for the IT function (including IT security) and cyber security are commensurate with the RE's IT maturity, digital depth, threat environment and industry standards and are utilised for the stated objectives.
obligations.quote: Ensure that the budgetary allocations for the IT function (including for IT security), cyber security are commensurate with the RE's IT maturity, digital depth, threat environment and industry standards

obligations.text: The Board of the RE shall, at least on an annual basis, review the adequacy and effectiveness of the Business Continuity Planning and Disaster Recovery Management of the RE.
obligations.quote: Review, at least on annual basis, the adequacy and effectiveness of the Business Continuity Planning and Disaster Recovery Management11 of the RE.

obligations.text: The Senior Management of the RE shall ensure execution of the IT Strategy approved by the Board.
obligations.quote: The Senior Management of the RE shall, inter alia, ensure: (i) Execution of the IT Strategy approved by the Board;

obligations.text: The Senior Management of the RE shall ensure that IT/IS and their support infrastructure are functioning effectively and efficiently.
obligations.quote: The Senior Management of the RE shall, inter alia, ensure: (i) Execution of the IT Strategy approved by the Board; (ii) IT/ IS and their support infrastructure are functioning effectively and efficiently;

obligations.text: The Senior Management of the RE shall ensure that necessary IT risk management processes are in place and create a culture of IT risk awareness and cyber hygiene practices in the RE.
obligations.quote: Necessary IT risk management processes are in place and create a culture of IT risk awareness and cyber hygiene practices in the RE;

obligations.text: The Senior Management of the RE shall ensure that the cyber security posture of the RE is robust.
obligations.quote: Cyber security posture of the RE is robust; and

obligations.text: The Senior Management of the RE shall ensure that overall, IT contributes to productivity, effectiveness and efficiency in business operations.
obligations.quote: Overall, IT contributes to productivity, effectiveness and efficiency in business operations.

obligations.text: REs shall establish an IT Steering Committee with representation at Senior Management level from IT and business functions.
obligations.quote: REs shall establish an IT Steering Committee with representation at Senior Management level from IT and business functions.

obligations.text: The IT Steering Committee shall assist the ITSC in strategic IT planning, oversight of IT performance, and aligning IT activities with business needs.
obligations.quote: The responsibilities of IT Steering Committee, inter alia, shall be to: (i) Assist the ITSC in strategic IT planning, oversight of IT performance, and aligning IT activities with business needs;

obligations.text: The IT Steering Committee shall oversee the processes put in place for business continuity and disaster recovery.
obligations.quote: (ii) Oversee the processes put in place for business continuity and disaster recovery;

obligations.text: The IT Steering Committee shall ensure implementation of a robust IT architecture meeting statutory and regulatory compliance.
obligations.quote: (iii) Ensure implementation of a robust IT architecture meeting statutory and regulatory compliance; and

obligations.text: The IT Steering Committee shall update the ITSC and CEO periodically on the activities of the IT Steering Committee.
obligations.quote: (iv) Update ITSC and CEO periodically on the activities of IT Steering Committee.

obligations.text: The IT Steering Committee shall meet at least on a quarterly basis.
obligations.quote: (d) The IT Steering Committee shall meet at least on a quarterly basis.

obligations.text: REs shall appoint a sufficiently senior level, technically competent and experienced official in IT related aspects as Head of IT Function.
obligations.quote: REs shall appoint a sufficiently senior level, technically competent and experienced official in IT related aspects as Head of IT Function

obligations.text: The Head of IT Function shall be responsible for ensuring that the execution of IT projects/initiatives is aligned with the RE's IT Policy and IT Strategy.
obligations.quote: The Head of IT Function shall, inter alia, be responsible for the following: (i) Ensuring that the execution of IT projects/ initiatives is aligned with the RE's IT Policy and IT Strategy

obligations.text: The Head of IT Function shall be responsible for ensuring that there is an effective organisational structure to support IT functions in the RE.
obligations.quote: (ii) Ensuring that there is an effective organisational structure to support IT functions in the RE; and

obligations.text: The Head of IT Function shall be responsible for putting in place an effective disaster recovery setup and business continuity strategy/plan.
obligations.quote: (iii) Putting in place an effective disaster recovery setup and business continuity strategy/ plan.

obligations.text: The Head of IT Function shall, as a first line of defence, ensure effective assessment, evaluation and management of IT controls and IT risk, including implementation of robust internal controls, to secure the RE's information assets and comply with extant internal policies, regulatory and legal requirements on IT related aspects.
obligations.quote: the Head of IT Function shall ensure effective assessment, evaluation and management of IT controls and IT risk, including the implementation of robust internal controls

obligations.text: REs shall put in place a robust IT Service Management Framework for supporting their information systems and infrastructure to ensure the operational resilience of their entire IT environment (including DR sites).
obligations.quote: REs shall put in place a robust IT Service Management Framework for supporting their information systems and infrastructure to ensure the operational resilience of their entire IT environment (including DR sites).

obligations.text: A Service Level Management (SLM) process shall be put in place to manage the IT operations while ensuring effective segregation of duties.
obligations.quote: A Service Level Management (SLM) process shall be put in place to manage the IT operations while ensuring effective segregation of duties.

obligations.text: REs shall ensure identification and mapping of the security classification (in terms of Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability) of information assets based on their criticality to the REs' operations.
obligations.quote: REs shall ensure identification and mapping of the security classification (in terms of Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability) of information assets based on their criticality to the REs’ operations.

obligations.text: REs shall avoid using outdated and unsupported hardware or software and shall monitor software's end-of-support (EOS) date and Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) dates of IT hardware on an ongoing basis.
obligations.quote: REs shall avoid using outdated and unsupported hardware or software and shall monitor software’s end-of-support (EOS) date and Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) dates of IT hardware on an ongoing basis.

obligations.text: REs shall develop a technology refresh plan for the replacement of hardware and software in a timely manner before they reach EOS.
obligations.quote: REs shall develop a technology refresh plan for the replacement of hardware and software in a timely manner before they reach EOS.

obligations.text: Where third-party arrangements in the IT/Cyber Security ecosystem are outside the Outsourcing of IT Services Directions, 2023, REs shall put in place appropriate vendor risk assessment process and controls proportionate to assessed risk and materiality.
obligations.quote: REs shall, put in place appropriate vendor risk assessment process and controls proportionate to the assessed risk and materiality

obligations.text: Vendor controls under such third-party arrangements must mitigate concentration risk, eliminate or address conflicts of interest, and mitigate single point of failure risks.
obligations.quote: mitigate concentration risk; eliminate or address any conflict of interests; mitigate risks associated with single point of failure;

obligations.text: Vendor controls under such third-party arrangements must comply with applicable legal and regulatory requirements and standards to protect customer data.
obligations.quote: comply with applicable legal, regulatory requirements and standards to protect customer data;

obligations.text: Vendor controls under such third-party arrangements must provide high availability for uninterrupted customer service.
obligations.quote: provide high availability (for uninterrupted customer service); and

obligations.text: Vendor controls under such third-party arrangements must manage supply chain risks effectively.
obligations.quote: manage supply chain risks effectively.

obligations.text: REs shall ensure that information systems and infrastructure are able to support business functions and ensure availability of all service delivery channels.
obligations.quote: REs shall ensure that information systems and infrastructure are able to support business functions and ensure availability of all service delivery channels.

obligations.text: REs shall proactively assess capacity requirements of IT resources on an annual or more frequent basis.
obligations.quote: On an annual or more frequent basis, REs shall proactively assess capacity requirement of IT resources.

obligations.text: REs shall ensure IT capacity planning across components, services, system resources and supporting infrastructure is consistent with past trends (peak usage), current business requirements and projected future needs per the RE's IT strategy.
obligations.quote: REs shall ensure that IT capacity planning across components, services, system resources, supporting infrastructure is consistent with past trends (peak usage)

obligations.text: The assessment of IT capacity requirements and measures taken to address issues shall be reviewed by the ITSC.
obligations.quote: The assessment of IT capacity requirements and measures taken to address the issues shall be reviewed by the ITSC.

obligations.text: REs shall follow a consistent and formally defined project management approach for IT projects undertaken by them.
obligations.quote: REs shall follow a consistent and formally defined project management approach for IT projects undertaken by them.

obligations.text: The project management approach shall enable appropriate stakeholder participation for effective monitoring and management of project risks and progress.
obligations.quote: The project management approach shall, inter alia, enable appropriate stakeholder participation for effective monitoring and management of project risks and progress.

obligations.text: While adopting new or emerging technologies, tools, or revamping existing ones in the technology stack, REs shall follow a standard enterprise architecture planning methodology or framework.
obligations.quote: While adopting new or emerging technologies, tools, or revamping their existing ones in the technology stack, REs shall follow a standard enterprise architecture planning methodology or framework.

obligations.text: Adoption of new or emerging technologies shall be commensurate with the risk appetite and align with the overall Business/IT strategy of the RE.
obligations.quote: Adoption of new or emerging technologies shall be commensurate with the risk appetite and align with overall Business/ IT strategy of the RE.

obligations.text: REs shall maintain an enterprise data dictionary to enable the sharing of data among applications and information systems and promote a common understanding of data.
obligations.quote: REs shall maintain enterprise data dictionary to enable the sharing of data among applications and information systems and promote a common understanding of data.

obligations.text: REs shall ensure that maintenance and necessary support of software applications is provided by the software vendors, enforced through formal agreement.
obligations.quote: REs shall ensure that maintenance and necessary support of software applications is provided by the software vendors and the same is enforced through formal agreement.

obligations.text: REs shall obtain the source codes for all critical applications from their vendors.
obligations.quote: REs shall obtain the source codes for all critical applications from their vendors.

obligations.text: Where obtaining source code is not possible, REs shall put in place a source code escrow arrangement or other arrangements to adequately mitigate the risk of default by the vendor.
obligations.quote: Where obtaining of the source code is not possible, REs shall put in place a source code escrow arrangement or other arrangements to adequately mitigate the risk of default by the vendor.

obligations.text: REs shall ensure that all product updates and programme fixes are included in the source code escrow arrangement.
obligations.quote: REs shall ensure that all product updates and programme fixes are included in the source code escrow arrangement.

obligations.text: REs shall obtain a certificate or written confirmation from the application developer or vendor stating that the application is free of known vulnerabilities, malware, and any covert channels in the code.
obligations.quote: REs shall obtain a certificate or a written confirmation from the application developer or vendor stating that the application is free of known vulnerabilities, malware, and any covert channels in the code.

obligations.text: A certificate or written confirmation of freedom from known vulnerabilities, malware and covert channels shall also be obtained whenever material changes to the code, including upgrades, occur.
obligations.quote: Such a certificate or a written confirmation shall also be obtained whenever material changes to the code, including upgrades, occur.

obligations.text: Any new IT application proposed to be introduced as a business product shall be subjected to product approval and quality assurance process.
obligations.applies_to: New IT applications proposed to be introduced as a business product
obligations.quote: Any new IT application proposed to be introduced as a business product13 shall be subjected to product approval and quality assurance process.

obligations.text: REs shall put in place documented policy(ies) and procedures for change and patch management to ensure that the business impact of implementing patches/changes (or not implementing a particular patch/change request) is assessed.
obligations.quote: REs shall put in place documented policy(ies) and procedures for change and patch management to ensure the following: the business impact of implementing patches/ changes

obligations.text: REs shall ensure that patches/changes are applied/implemented and reviewed in a secure and timely manner with necessary approvals.
obligations.quote: the patches/ changes are applied/ implemented and reviewed in a secure and timely manner with necessary approvals;

obligations.text: REs shall ensure that any changes to an application system or data are justified by genuine business needs and approvals supported by documentation, and are subjected to a robust change management process.
obligations.quote: any changes to an application system or data are justified by genuine business needs and approvals supported by documentation and subjected to a robust change management process

obligations.text: REs shall establish a mechanism to recover from failed changes/patch deployment or unexpected results.
obligations.quote: mechanism is established to recover from failed changes/ patch deployment or unexpected results.

obligations.text: REs shall have a documented data migration policy specifying a systematic process for data migration, ensuring data integrity, completeness and consistency.
obligations.quote: REs shall have a documented data migration policy specifying a systematic process for data migration, ensuring data integrity, completeness and consistency.

obligations.text: The data migration policy shall contain provisions pertaining to signoffs from business users and application owners at each stage of migration, and maintenance of audit trails, etc.
obligations.quote: The policy shall, inter alia, contain provisions pertaining to signoffs from business users and application owners at each stage of migration, maintenance of audit trails, etc.

obligations.text: Every IT application which can access or affect critical or sensitive information shall have necessary audit and system logging capability.
obligations.applies_to: Every IT application which can access or affect critical or sensitive information (REs)
obligations.quote: Every IT application which can access or affect critical or sensitive information, shall have necessary audit and system logging capability and should provide audit trails.

obligations.text: The audit trails shall satisfy a RE's business requirements apart from regulatory and legal requirements.
obligations.quote: The audit trails shall satisfy a RE's business requirements apart from regulatory and legal requirements.

obligations.text: The audit trails must be detailed enough to facilitate the conduct of audit, serve as forensic evidence when required and assist in dispute resolution, including for non-repudiation purposes.
obligations.quote: The audit trails must be detailed enough to facilitate the conduct of audit, serve as forensic evidence when required and assist in dispute resolution, including for non-repudiation purposes.

obligations.text: REs shall put in place a system for regularly monitoring the audit trails and system logs to detect any unauthorised activity.
obligations.quote: REs shall put in place a system for regularly monitoring the audit trails and system logs to detect any unauthorised activity.

obligations.text: The key length, algorithms, cipher suites and applicable protocols used in transmission channels, processing of data and authentication purpose shall be strong.
obligations.quote: The key length, algorithms, cipher suites and applicable protocols used in transmission channels, processing of data and authentication purpose shall be strong.

obligations.text: REs shall adopt internationally accepted and published standards that are not deprecated, demonstrated to be insecure or vulnerable.
obligations.quote: REs shall adopt internationally accepted and published standards that are not deprecated/ demonstrated to be insecure/ vulnerable and the configurations involved in implementing such controls shall be compliant with extant laws and regulatory instructions.

obligations.text: The configurations involved in implementing cryptographic controls shall be compliant with extant laws and regulatory instructions.
obligations.quote: the configurations involved in implementing such controls shall be compliant with extant laws and regulatory instructions.

obligations.text: REs shall ensure there is no manual intervention or manual modification in data while it is being transferred from one process to another or from one application to another, in respect of critical applications.
obligations.quote: REs shall ensure that there is no manual intervention or manual modification in data while it is being transferred from one process to another or from one application to another, in respect of critical applications.

obligations.text: Data transfer mechanisms between processes or applications must be properly tested, securely automated with necessary checks and balances, and properly integrated through Straight Through Processing methodology with appropriate authentication mechanism and audit trails.
obligations.applies_to: Data transfer mechanism between processes or applications
obligations.quote: Data transfer mechanism between processes or applications must be properly tested, securely automated with necessary checks and balances, and properly integrated through "Straight Through Processing" methodology with appropriate authentication mechanism and audit trails.

obligations.text: REs shall implement suitable physical and environmental controls in Data Centre and Disaster Recovery sites used by them.
obligations.quote: REs shall implement suitable physical and environmental controls in Data Centre and Disaster Recovery14 sites used by them.

obligations.text: REs shall ensure that their DC and DR sites are subjected to necessary e-surveillance mechanism.
obligations.quote: REs shall ensure that their DC and DR sites are subjected to necessary e- surveillance mechanism.

obligations.text: Access to information assets shall be allowed only where a valid business need exists.
obligations.quote: Access to information assets shall be allowed only where a valid business need exists.

obligations.text: REs shall have documented standards and procedures, approved by the ITSC and kept up to date, for administering need-based access to an information system.
obligations.quote: REs shall have documented standards and procedures, which are approved by the ITSC and kept up to date for administering need-based access to an information system.

obligations.text: Personnel with elevated system access entitlements shall be closely supervised, with all their systems activities logged and periodically reviewed.
obligations.applies_to: Personnel with elevated system access entitlements
obligations.quote: Personnel with elevated system access entitlements shall be closely supervised with all their systems activities logged and periodically reviewed.

obligations.text: REs shall adopt multi-factor authentication for privileged users of critical information systems and for critical activities, basis the RE's risk assessment.
obligations.quote: REs shall adopt multi-factor authentication for privileged users of i) critical information systems and ii) for critical activities, basis the RE’s risk assessment.

obligations.text: In the teleworking environment, REs shall ensure that the systems used and the remote access from alternate work location to the environment hosting RE's information assets are secure.
obligations.quote: Ensure that the systems used and the remote access from alternate work location to the environment hosting RE’s information assets are secure;

obligations.text: In the teleworking environment, REs shall implement multi-factor authentication for enterprise access (logical) to critical systems.
obligations.quote: Implement multi-factor authentication for enterprise access (logical) to critical systems;

obligations.text: In the teleworking environment, REs shall put in place a mechanism to identify all remote-access devices attached or connected to the RE's systems.
obligations.quote: Put in place a mechanism to identify all remote-access devices attached/ connected to the RE’s systems; and

obligations.text: In the teleworking environment, REs shall ensure that data/information shared or presented in teleworking is secured appropriately.
obligations.quote: Ensure that data/ information shared/ presented in teleworking is secured appropriately.

obligations.text: REs shall define suitable metrics for system performance, recovery and business resumption, including RPO and RTO, for all critical information systems.
obligations.quote: REs shall define suitable metrics for system performance, recovery and business resumption, including Recovery Point Objective (RPO) and Recovery Time Objective (RTO), for all critical information systems.

obligations.text: For non-critical information systems, REs shall adopt a risk-based approach to define suitable metrics.
obligations.quote: For non-critical information systems, REs shall adopt a risk-based approach to define suitable metrics.

obligations.text: REs shall implement suitable scorecard/ metrics/ methodology to measure IT performance and IT maturity level.
obligations.quote: REs shall implement suitable scorecard/ metrics/ methodology to measure IT performance and IT maturity level.

obligations.text: The risk management policy of the RE shall include IT related risks, including the Cyber Security related risks.
obligations.quote: The risk management policy of the RE shall include IT related risks, including the Cyber Security related risks, and the Risk Management Committee of the Board

obligations.text: The Risk Management Committee of the Board (RMCB), in consultation with the ITSC, shall periodically review and update the risk management policy at least on a yearly basis.
obligations.applies_to: Risk Management Committee of the Board (RMCB)
obligations.deadline: at least on a yearly basis
obligations.quote: the Risk Management Committee of the Board (RMCB) in consultation with the ITSC shall periodically review and update the same at least on a yearly basis.

obligations.text: REs shall establish a robust IT and Information Security Risk Management Framework covering, inter alia, the specified aspects.
obligations.quote: REs shall establish a robust IT and Information Security Risk Management Framework15 covering, inter alia, the following aspects:

obligations.text: REs shall implement comprehensive Information Security management function, internal controls and processes (including applicable insurance covers) to mitigate/manage identified risks.
obligations.quote: Implementation of comprehensive Information Security management function, internal controls and processes (including applicable insurance covers) to mitigate/ manage identified risks.

obligations.text: The implemented controls and processes must be reviewed periodically on their efficacy in a risk environment characterised by change.
obligations.quote: The implemented controls and processes must be reviewed periodically on their efficacy in a risk environment characterised by change;

obligations.text: REs must define roles and responsibilities of stakeholders (including third-party personnel) involved in IT risk management.
obligations.quote: Definition of roles and responsibilities of stakeholders (including third-party personnel) involved in IT risk management.

obligations.text: Areas of possible role conflicts and accountability gaps must be specifically identified and eliminated or managed.
obligations.quote: Areas of possible role conflicts and accountability gaps must be specifically identified and eliminated or managed

obligations.text: REs shall identify critical information systems of the organisation and fortify the security environment of such systems.
obligations.quote: Identification of critical information systems of the organisation and fortification of the security environment of such systems; and

obligations.text: REs shall define and implement necessary systems, procedures and controls to ensure secure storage/transmission/processing of data/information.
obligations.quote: Definition and implementation of necessary systems, procedures and controls to ensure secure storage/ transmission/ processing of data/ information.

obligations.text: The Information Security Policy shall take into consideration aspects such as objectives, scope, ownership and responsibility for the Policy; information security organisational structure; exceptions; compliance review; and penal measures for non-compliance of Policies.
obligations.quote: The Information Security Policy shall take into consideration, inter alia, aspects such as the objectives, scope, ownership and responsibility for the Policy; information security organisational structure; exceptions;

obligations.text: REs shall put in place a Cyber Security Policy and a Cyber Crisis Management Plan (CCMP).
obligations.quote: REs shall also put in place a Cyber Security Policy and Cyber Crisis Management Plan (CCMP).

obligations.text: An Information Security Committee (ISC), under the oversight of the ITSC, shall be formed for managing cyber/information security.
obligations.quote: An Information Security Committee (ISC), under the oversight of the ITSC, shall be formed for managing cyber/ information security.

obligations.text: The head of the ISC shall be from the risk management vertical.
obligations.quote: The head of the ISC shall be from risk management vertical.

obligations.text: The ISC shall develop information/cyber security policies and implement policies, standards and procedures to ensure all identified risks are managed within the RE's risk appetite.
obligations.quote: Development of information/ cyber security policies, implementation of policies, standards and procedures to ensure that all identified risks are managed within the RE's risk appetite;

obligations.text: The ISC shall approve and monitor information security projects and security awareness initiatives.
obligations.quote: Approving and monitoring information security projects and security awareness initiatives;

obligations.text: The ISC shall review cyber incidents, information systems audit observations, monitoring and mitigation activities.
obligations.quote: Reviewing cyber incidents, information systems audit observations, monitoring and mitigation activities; and

obligations.text: The ISC shall update the ITSC and CEO periodically on its activities.
obligations.quote: Updating ITSC and CEO periodically on the activities of ISC.

obligations.text: A senior level executive (preferably a General Manager or equivalent) shall be designated as the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO).
obligations.quote: A senior level executive (preferably in the rank of a General Manager or an equivalent position) shall be designated as the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO).

obligations.text: The CISO shall not have any direct reporting relationship with the Head of IT Function.
obligations.quote: The CISO shall not have any direct reporting relationship with the Head of IT Function and shall not be given any business targets.

obligations.text: The CISO shall not be given any business targets.
obligations.quote: The CISO shall not have any direct reporting relationship with the Head of IT Function and shall not be given any business targets.

obligations.text: REs shall ensure the CISO has the requisite technical background and expertise.
obligations.quote: The CISO has the requisite technical background and expertise;

obligations.text: REs shall ensure the CISO is appointed for a reasonable minimum term.
obligations.quote: She/He is appointed for a reasonable minimum term;

obligations.text: REs shall ensure the CISO's Office is adequately staffed with people having necessary technical expertise, commensurate with business volume, extent of technology adoption and complexity.
obligations.quote: The CISO's Office is adequately staffed with people having necessary technical expertise, commensurate with the business volume, extent of technology adoption and complexity; and

obligations.text: REs shall ensure that the roles and responsibilities of the CISO are clearly defined and documented covering, at a minimum, the specified points.
obligations.quote: REs shall ensure that the roles and responsibilities of the CISO are clearly defined and documented covering, at a minimum, the following points:
